newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo rubber prices stable despite heavy supply.
newsitem.headline: Colombo rubber prices stable despite heavy supply.

text.p: Rubber prices were stable at the Colombo auction on Friday, despite large seasonal quantities that have come into the market, brokers said.
On Friday 591 tonnes was offered on top of the 600 tonnes offered at the last auction on Tuesday.
"Normally where we would have 500-600 tonnes of rubber a week, this time we have had close upon 1,200 tonnes," said Upali Bandaranayake of brokerage Forbes & Walker.
